## Requirement disposition

| Brief | Repository behavior and evidence |
|---|---|
| R1 | Passive cost ledger; no enforcement; legacy budget arguments ignored |
| R2, A1, A2, A3 | Authenticated loopback API; separate operator credential; bounded remote jobs |
| R3, D2 | Guard inventory in ARCHITECTURE; normal testing-phase iteration |
| R4, C1, C2 | All services non-root, no Docker socket/CLI, durable worker |
| A4, C3 | Private Neo4j supervisor with clean-stop backup; desktop uses HTTP |
| A5 | Split config, empty-is-unset, atomic model-only pins on a named volume |
| B1 | Typed temperature/token/reasoning knobs and recorded request parameters |
| B2, B3 | Catalogue validation, honest stage/date, measured flow tested with mocks |
| C4 | Dash removed from shipped topology; legacy code retained for compatibility |
| D1 | Disposable graph tests and CI with JUnit evidence; desktop full-flow suite |
| E1 | Clean-source deployment, revision endpoint/labels, immutable image IDs and records |
| E2, E3 | Generated authoritative runtime docs and mechanical drift checks |
| E4 | Known OI rows tracked; original ignored 18-finding trail absent, cannot reconstruct |
| Minor OI-06, OI-07, OI-08 | Typo, dead timeout and expansion bookkeeping already corrected |

No live measured-model run is claimed: tests never make paid inference calls.
No release/deployed SHA is claimed until an administrator invokes deployment.
The missing original E4 review trail remains an external evidence gap. Historical
OI-01/OI-03/OI-09 deployment facts are not inferred from disposable verification.
OPEN_ISSUES retains append-only history and rerunnable closure evidence.

## Verification

Canonical environment: `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=venv uv sync --frozen --all-packages`.
Run ruff, mypy, docs checks, root unit, desktop unit/contract, integration,
acceptance (separately), and desktop integration. Set `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`
on headless hosts; constrained WebEngine test hosts may need Chromium test flags.
Graph suites own disposable containers and volumes. Only a dedicated external
test database may be selected via `LIMES_TEST_NEO4J_URI`; never operator data.
The physical-backup test builds the real supervisor image, uses non-root services,
checks unauthenticated refusal, verifies a nonempty dump and graph recovery.
Worker queue tests cover replay protection, concurrent claims, output bounds,
parameter rejection and failed process exit codes. Runtime tests reject privilege,
port, source and documentation drift. Production smoke is a separate administrator
action; integration smoke uses only disposable configuration and mocked paid paths.
